claims.text:
28. forecast-fan

Target / packet: ai-forecast-fan · F1. Prerequisites: ai:persistence-forecast, big-ideas:chaos-butterfly.

Nearest / distinct payoff: persistence-forecast → ai-persistence-forecast. A point forecast gives one number; this propagates explicit process-noise paths and distinguishes a standard-deviation band from its actual covered mass.

Finite primary model: Random walk X_h=10+sum(noise_i), independent noise±1 equally. h=1 outcomes 9/11 sd 1; h=2 outcomes 8,10,12 masses.25,.5,.25 sd sqrt 2; h=4 variance 4, sd 2. Report mean±sd as spread band, not confidence interval.

Countercase and mathematical boundary: Perfectly correlated noise uses one shared sign: h=4 outcomes 6/14, variance 16, sd 4. Independence changes widening law. Intervals are not automatically nominal 68/95 coverage for discrete walks.

Predict and recall transfer: Predict which model widens faster; recall h=2 independent band 10±sqrt 2 covers mass=.5, not 68%.

Required observable evidence: Enumerate finite walk outcomes/masses and label band definition explicitly; no invented forecast uncertainty from real data.

Source obligation: Declared local finite model. Exact results require independent arithmetic reproduction; this construction supports no real-model performance or universal improvement claim. Method-source obligations remain as listed in the acquisition record below.
